messages:
maria (partnerships): FYI AWS Marketplace intake asked for our compliance bundle for the listing verification. They want SOC2, external pentest (redacted if needed), inventory of in-scope hosts, and vendor attestations. Deadline: next Mon 09:00 PT. Can @tyler + @june take point? Link to portal: https://aws.amazon.com/marketplace/management/portal/upload :wave:
tyler (security): I can handle technical review. Quick: do they accept a signed pentest summary instead of the full report? Also need to confirm scope (production only).
june (legal): Ill check marketplace agreement clauses around vendor reports and customer data. If Shield/BlueFort report has third-party customer identifiers we must redact. I can prepare a minimal NDA addendum if vendor requests.
kevin (product): We have the SOC2 PDF in vault: s3://redwood-compliance/2025/soc2_type_ii_2025.pdf. I can stage everything in a partners bucket and post presigned links.
artifact-uploader-bot: Created temp bucket: s3://partners/aws-evidence-1765567890. Run `/grant partners/aws-evidence-1765567890 tyler@redwood.com june@redwood.com kevin@redwood.com maria@redwood.com` to grant access.
tyler (security): Thanks. Maria what exact filenames do they want? Portal prefers lowercase, underscores, no spaces. Example checklist usually lists something like `soc2_type_ii.pdf`, `external_pentest_redacted.pdf`, `in_scope_hosts.tsv`, `vendor_attestations.pdf`, `remediation_tracker.csv`.
maria (partnerships): Their snippet:
```
- soc2_type_ii_2025.pdf
- pentest_external_2025_redacted.pdf
- in_scope_hosts.tsv
- vendor_attestations.pdf
- remediation_tracker.csv
```
They also ask for a primary contact and emergency security contact.
kevin (product): I'll generate `in_scope_hosts.tsv` (hosts + CIDRs + service tags) and `remediation_tracker.csv` with current statuses. ETA EOD today. Ill put presigned links here when uploads complete.
june (legal): I'll review the pentest for PII and redact names/IPs not in scope. If the pen-test vendor requires an NDA for upload, I'll send our marketplace NDA + vendor addendum.
tyler (security): We should include a short attestation PDF from the pen-test vendor if they won't let the full doc leave their environment: `pentest_attestation_signed.pdf` that states scope, date, and that redactions were applied. That usually satisfies marketplace reviewers.
kevin (product): Vendor: BlueFort Labs (eng@bluefort.io). I'll ask for the attestation and permission to host the redacted report.
june (legal): Noted. I'll queue the NDA template: https://redwood/legal/templates/marketplace_vendor_nda.pdf. Will tailor and send to BlueFort tonight.
artifact-uploader-bot: Grant command executed for tyler@redwood.com and kevin@redwood.com. Access pending for june@redwood.com (manual approval required).
tyler (security): Once redacted pentest is in the bucket Ill validate no PII/identifiers and assemble the `mitigations_summary.md` with per-finding status. Also prefer we include CVSS scores in `remediation_tracker.csv`.
maria (partnerships): Great. If anyone thinks we need more time, shout now; otherwise I'll push to meet AWS deadline. I prefer no extension. :rocket:
kevin (product): Uploaded draft files to the bucket and generated presigned links (will paste after june gets access). Also following the filename convention.
june (legal): Uploaded redacted pentest as `pentest_external_2025_redacted.pdf` and sent NDA to BlueFort. Ping @tyler when you can review.
tyler (security): Reviewing now. If clean, Ill sign the attestation and we can hand off to @maria for portal upload.
maria (partnerships): Thanks team this thread is the single source of truth for the listing artifacts. Post any portal confirmations here and Ill close the loop with AWS listing team. :+1:
